title: Dark Clouds Rising in Low-Earth Orbit: On Environmental Limits to Massive Orbital AI
authors: Robin Ohs; Gregory F. Stock; Andreas Schmidt; Juan A. Fraire; Jörg Ott; Holger Hermanns
affiliations: Saarland University, Inria Lyon, Technical University of Munich
research_focus: Energy / Carbon, Hardware co-design, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: Lifecycle analysis must account for power infrastructure, waste-heat rejection and payload redundancy.
problem_statement.zh: lifecycle analysis 需要納入 power infrastructure、waste-heat rejection 與 payload redundancy。

key_innovation.en: ESpaS-ODC adds ISS-calibrated radiator sizing, solar degradation, eclipse margins and shared-infrastructure cold spares.
key_innovation.zh: ESpaS-ODC 加入經 ISS 校準的 radiator sizing、solar degradation、eclipse margin，以及共享 infrastructure 的 cold spare。

baselines_compared: Global-average terrestrial DC and Finland-grid green DC; Starship and Falcon9 launch assumptions.

key_improvements.en: The reported reference case has44.3 kg modeled component mass, including30.5 kg radiator (68.8%). One full cold spare increases3-year carbon per GPU hour by40% under Starship and34% under Falcon9.
key_improvements.zh: 報告 reference case 的 modeled component mass 為 44.3 kg，包含 30.5 kg radiator（68.8%）；一組完整 cold spare 在三年期下，使 Starship 假設的 carbon per GPU hour 提升 40%，Falcon9 假設提升 34%。

source.scope_en: The component ledger covers an ideal100% duty cycle and a50W transceiver placeholder. Bus, harness, shielding and thermal transport require additional mass accounting; reliability benefits require measured failure rates.
source.scope_zh: component ledger 涵蓋理想 100% duty cycle 與 50 W transceiver placeholder；bus、harness、shielding 與 thermal transport 需要額外 mass accounting，reliability benefit 需要實測 failure rate。
